Sobre a vaga

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Job-Type: Contract

Salary Range: $25 – 35/hr.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to work in a predominantly on-premise Microsoft ecosystem. This role is responsible for driving automation, CI/CD pipeline optimization, infrastructure reliability, release management, and operational governance across development and infrastructure teams.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Windows Server environments, Microsoft tooling, infrastructure automation, and release orchestration.

Duties & Responsibilities:

· Work on a small DevOps team supporting development and infrastructure functions.

· Help to define and implement DevOps standards, automation practices, and release governance.

· Partner with Architecture, Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure teams to improve delivery velocity and operational stability.

· Manage and automate Windows Server environments, IIS, Active Directory integrations, and SQL Server deployments.

· Support virtualization platforms (VMware) and internal networking configurations.

· Drive improvements in uptime, performance, patching, and disaster recovery processes.

Required Experience & Skills:

· 7+ years in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or related roles

· Leadership and/or team management experience

· Strong experience in Windows Server, IIS, Active Directory, and SQL Server environments

· Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Server or similar)

· Proficiency in PowerShell and automation scripting

· Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware)

· Strong understanding of release management and operational best practices

· Experience using Docker for containerization in on-prem settings

Nice to Have Experience:

· Experience modernizing legacy/on-prem environments toward hybrid cloud

· Familiarity with TeamCity

· Exposure to monitoring and logging platforms (SCOM, Splunk, ELK)

· Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code in private data centers

Gravity IT Resources provides the consulting expertise and IT talent that powers digital transformation. We employ consistent, innovative strategies across multiple practice areas to help our clients leverage technology to drive bottom line results. We offer contract/staff augmentation, contract-to-hire and direct hire/direct placement staffing services of IT professionals. These services are tailored to meet the specific needs of several different market segments including Commercial, Healthcare and Government. We have specialized teams and resources for delivering our staffing services for specific IT skill sets including Salesforce, ServiceNow and Digital Transformation. We also have a Cloud Analytics consulting practice focused on helping clients leverage modern cloud data and analytics tools to improve corporate decision making in Marketing, Sales and Operations functions.
